metadata.purpose: Manuscript-ready robustness layer around the accepted synchronized Framingham GEN versus BAU dynamic LCA results.
metadata.positive_delta_meaning: GEN has lower impact than BAU
metadata.calculation_scope: Reduced calibrated robustness layer; not a full nested Brightway/bw_timex stochastic rerun.

deterministic_scenarios.label: Accepted synchronized base case
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Reference point for all robustness calculations.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: No sensitivity; anchors all deltas to the accepted base case.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Internal source: accepted synchronized LCIA exports and QA docs.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN effective heat-pump performance x0.90
deterministic_scenarios.base_treatment: Accepted GEN heating electricity from HEATNETS rerun
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Heat-pump field performance is a core operational uncertainty for geothermal networks.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Whether lower-than-base GEN heat-pump performance narrows the GEN advantage.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Increases GEN Stage B and narrows BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Staffell et al. (2012), doi:10.1039/C2EE22653G; Pratiwi and Trutnevyte (2021), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2020.101988; internal B6 QA.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Screening layer scales accepted operational electricity rather than rerunning HEATNETS.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN effective heat-pump performance x1.10
deterministic_scenarios.base_treatment: Accepted GEN heating electricity from HEATNETS rerun
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests a plausible higher-performance GEN operation case.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Whether better heat-pump performance increases the GEN advantage.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Decreases GEN Stage B and increases BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Staffell et al. (2012), doi:10.1039/C2EE22653G; Godinaud et al. (2024), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2024.102996.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Does not alter delivered service or infrastructure scope.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN Stage A / infrastructure burden x0.85
deterministic_scenarios.base_treatment: Accepted GEN Stage A dynamic climate burden
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: GEN is front-loaded; infrastructure uncertainty can materially affect the comparison.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Lower borehole, piping, equipment, or installation intensity.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Decreases GEN total and increases BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Pratiwi and Trutnevyte (2021), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2020.101988; Godinaud et al. (2024), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2024.102996.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Applies a stage-level screen and does not change component bill of materials.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN Stage A / infrastructure burden x1.15
deterministic_scenarios.base_treatment: Accepted GEN Stage A dynamic climate burden
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests robustness to higher-than-base infrastructure intensity.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Higher drilling, piping, heat-pump, or installation burden.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Increases GEN total and narrows BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Pratiwi and Trutnevyte (2021), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2020.101988; Uhrmann et al. (2025), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2025.103475.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Stage-level multiplier should be described as screening, not a component-level redesign.

deterministic_scenarios.label: BAU all space heating as gas furnace, AFUE 90%
deterministic_scenarios.figure_label: BAU all space heat gas AFUE 90%
deterministic_scenarios.sensitivity_value: All BAU space heating converted to gas furnace AFUE 90%; DHW and cooling unchanged
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests BAU counterfactual pathway structure, not GEN performance.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Increases BAU Stage B and increases BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Alvarez et al. (2018), doi:10.1126/science.aar7204; Staffell et al. (2012), doi:10.1039/C2EE22653G; internal BAU reconstruction.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: This is a BAU counterfactual structure test and should not be framed as GEN uncertainty.

deterministic_scenarios.label: BAU non-FHA fossil space heating to electric resistance, COP 1.0
deterministic_scenarios.figure_label: BAU non-FHA fossil heat to resistance
deterministic_scenarios.sensitivity_value: All non-FHA fossil space heating converted to electric resistance COP 1.0; DHW and cooling unchanged
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests a more electrified BAU pathway using a conservative COP 1.0 branch.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Whether GEN remains lower when BAU fossil space heat shifts to direct electric resistance.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Usually lowers BAU direct combustion and narrows BAU - GEN under prospective electricity.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Staffell et al. (2012), doi:10.1039/C2EE22653G; Alvarez et al. (2018), doi:10.1126/science.aar7204; internal BAU reconstruction.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: This tests BAU transition structure; it is not an uncertainty in the GEN model.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN pump / auxiliary electricity x0.80
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Auxiliary electricity is a recognized geothermal-network LCA driver.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Lower pump and loop auxiliary energy.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Decreases GEN Stage B and increases BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Uhrmann et al. (2025), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2025.103475; Gkousis et al. (2022), doi:10.1016/j.apenergy.2022.120176.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Does not rerun hydraulics or loop controls.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN pump / auxiliary electricity x1.20
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests sensitivity to higher network/pump support energy.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Higher loop and auxiliary electricity demand.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Increases GEN Stage B and narrows BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Uhrmann et al. (2025), doi:10.1016/j.geothermics.2025.103475; Gkousis et al. (2022), doi:10.1016/j.apenergy.2022.120176.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Screening layer only; not a new HEATNETS control simulation.

deterministic_scenarios.label: GEN DHW constant COP 2.8
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: DHW was added explicitly and needs a conservative treatment check.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: A lower constant DHW COP compared with the accepted load-weighted surrogate.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Increases GEN Stage B and narrows BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Staffell et al. (2012), doi:10.1039/C2EE22653G; internal B6 QA.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Applies only to DHW electricity, not space-conditioning heat-pump performance.

deterministic_scenarios.label: BAU commercial cooling electricity x0.85
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Commercial cooling was a QA-sensitive BAU operation term.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Lower commercial cooling energy in BAU.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Decreases BAU Stage B and narrows BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Internal BAU QA and scenario rationale; Wernet et al. (2016), doi:10.1007/s11367-016-1087-8 for background LCI context.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Uses calibrated marginal electricity factor rather than full LCIA rerun.

deterministic_scenarios.label: BAU commercial cooling electricity x1.15
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests higher corrected BAU cooling electricity.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Higher commercial cooling energy in BAU.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Increases BAU Stage B and increases BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Internal BAU QA and scenario rationale; Wernet et al. (2016), doi:10.1007/s11367-016-1087-8 for background LCI context.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Uses calibrated marginal electricity factor rather than full LCIA rerun.

deterministic_scenarios.label: BAU FHA heat-pump branch: heating COP 2.5, DHW COP 2.2
deterministic_scenarios.base_treatment: Accepted FHA electric branch in BAU inventory
deterministic_scenarios.sensitivity_value: FHA heating COP = 2.5; FHA DHW COP = 2.2
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests whether a higher-performance electric FHA branch narrows the BAU burden.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: A BAU counterfactual in which FHA electric service is heat-pump supplied rather than resistance-like.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Decreases BAU electricity and narrows BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Staffell et al. (2012), doi:10.1039/C2EE22653G; internal BAU pathway sensitivity.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: This is a BAU counterfactual pathway check, not GEN uncertainty.

deterministic_scenarios.label: BAU west residential gas/oil split 60/40
deterministic_scenarios.sensitivity_value: West residential useful space heat split: 60% gas / 40% oil
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests sensitivity to BAU fuel-assignment structure.
deterministic_scenarios.what_it_tests: Higher oil share in the west residential BAU branch.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Usually increases BAU fossil intensity and increases BAU - GEN.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Alvarez et al. (2018), doi:10.1126/science.aar7204; internal fuel-share assumptions.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Tests counterfactual structure; exact parcel-level fuel assignments remain model assumptions.

deterministic_scenarios.label: Terminal background held at 2050
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Time-explicit LCIA depends on how future backgrounds are relinked near the terminal years.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: System-specific; reported as method robustness rather than physical uncertainty.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Method-structure branch; conventional static is not affected.

deterministic_scenarios.label: Replacement schedule -5 years
deterministic_scenarios.sensitivity_value: Major replacement events shifted 5 years earlier
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Dynamic climate LCIA is sensitive to timing of replacement pulses.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Small method-dependent change; earlier pulses often increase dynamic burden.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Uses scaled structural deltas rather than rebuilding timed inventories.

deterministic_scenarios.label: Replacement schedule +5 years
deterministic_scenarios.sensitivity_value: Major replacement events shifted 5 years later
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Tests robustness to later replacement timing in a time-explicit climate workflow.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Small method-dependent change; later pulses often reduce dynamic burden.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: Uses scaled structural deltas rather than rebuilding timed inventories.

deterministic_scenarios.label: Generic recycling sensitivity versus Framingham no-recycling core
deterministic_scenarios.reason_for_inclusion: Shows why the manuscript keeps generic recycling out of the core case.
deterministic_scenarios.expected_direction: Small change; Stage C remains minor and routing-sensitive.
deterministic_scenarios.references: Internal EOL audit and accepted EOL comparison; Wernet et al. (2016), doi:10.1007/s11367-016-1087-8 for background LCI context.
deterministic_scenarios.caution: SI only; do not use Stage C as a major benefit claim.

monte_carlo.description: Paired/shared reduced calibrated Monte Carlo. The same draw is applied consistently to GEN, BAU, and method-relevant shared assumptions where applicable.

parameters.label: GEN infrastructure intensity
parameters.rationale: GEN is front-loaded; Stage A uncertainty directly tests the central GEN model contribution.
parameters.references: Pratiwi and Trutnevyte (2021); Godinaud et al. (2024); internal Stage A results.

parameters.label: GEN effective heating/COP multiplier
parameters.units: multiplier on accepted effective heating COP
parameters.rationale: Heat-pump field performance affects GEN operational electricity.
parameters.references: Staffell et al. (2012); Pratiwi and Trutnevyte (2021); internal B6 QA.

parameters.label: GEN pump/auxiliary electricity multiplier
parameters.rationale: Auxiliary electricity is a geothermal-network driver.
parameters.references: Uhrmann et al. (2025); Gkousis et al. (2022); internal HEATNETS audit.

parameters.label: GEN DHW effective COP/treatment
parameters.rationale: DHW was explicitly added and should be tested against a conservative constant COP.
parameters.references: Staffell et al. (2012); internal B6 QA.

parameters.label: BAU heating efficiency
parameters.units: multiplier on useful heat per unit input
parameters.rationale: BAU operation dominates BAU climate burden.
parameters.references: Alvarez et al. (2018); Staffell et al. (2012); internal BAU reconstruction.

parameters.label: BAU commercial cooling electricity
parameters.rationale: Commercial cooling was corrected during QA and remains a bounded BAU operation term.
parameters.references: Internal B6 QA; Wernet et al. (2016).

parameters.label: BAU fuel-structure/oil-share modifier
parameters.rationale: Fuel assignment is a BAU counterfactual structure uncertainty.
parameters.references: Alvarez et al. (2018); internal BAU fuel-share assumptions.

parameters.label: Terminal-background handling
parameters.rationale: Future-background rule is a method-structure branch in time-explicit LCA.
parameters.references: Muller et al. (2025); Sacchi et al. (2022); internal scenario rationale.
